function.name: run_command
function.description: Run one bounded, read-only command against the target binary. Allowed: file, readelf, objdump, nm, strings, size, c++filt and text filters (grep, rg, sed, awk, head, tail, sort, uniq, wc, cut). For pipelines use exactly ["sh","-lc","objdump -d -Mintel <binary> | grep -n -C 8 '6f64d' | head -60"]. Only the one target binary may be inspected; debug/source options and other files are rejected.

argv.description: Command argv. Do not put pipe tokens directly in argv; use ["sh","-lc","..."] for pipelines.

timeout_sec.description: Timeout in seconds. Use 0 for default (240).

max_output_chars.description: Maximum stdout head/tail characters retained. Use 0 for default (60000).

function.name: strings_grep
function.description: Run `strings -a -tx` on the target binary and return matching offset-bearing lines. Use to find format strings, error strings, option names, and constants from the patch metadata, with their hex offsets.

max_matches.description: Maximum matching lines. Use 0 for default (80).

function.name: objdump_window
function.description: Return a bounded objdump disassembly window of the target binary between two addresses.

max_output_chars.description: Maximum output characters. Use 0 for default (30000).

function.name: submit_detection_result
function.description: Submit the final patch-presence verdict. Call exactly once when ready. Determinate verdicts (present/absent/not_affected) must cite at least one evidence_id from a prior tool call.
